correctness.rationale: For every b>=2 the aligned length-b blocks contain b distinct residues modulo b+1 and miss exactly a_j-1. The exact digit-carry equality s_b(q)-s_b(q-1)=1-(b-1)nu_b(q) determines first missing-symbol offsets. In even bases each odd q has zero valuation and each pair finishes exactly one greedy arch at its final letter. In odd bases the missing color in an odd-indexed block occurs at offset d=(-2(nu_b(q)+1) mod b+1), always even and within that block, while the succeeding even block cannot complete a second arch; induction gives all positions and arbitrary prefix formula. Bounds and attained extrema follow by explicit residues. A standalone verifier independently checked 91,029 prefixes, 58,000 carry identities and 155 brute-subsequence instances; the infinite proof is symbolic and does not infer from sampling.

value.rationale: A complete all-prefix exact evaluation of a natural scattered-subsequence coverage invariant for an unbounded classical family of automatic sequences, not merely evaluation of a chosen finite slice. The b versus b+1 mismatch creates a nontrivial missing-letter pattern, and the proof uncovers a sharp parity distinction plus carry-valuation-controlled early arch endings, with exact limiting rate and sharp discrepancy. These conclusions are not textbook consequences of automaticity or a general finite-word scanning algorithm and permit exact logarithmic-digit computation of the invariant.
